content.content: Every word after the candidate travels to the handler untouched and uninterpreted, including leading dashes. The dispatcher builds the argument envelope and never reads inside it; interpretation belongs to the verb.
content.rationale: Delegation is what keeps top-level parsing from becoming a per-verb parser; stating non-interpretation as the dispatcher's own abstinence — rather than as a property of the args — keeps flag-like words routable without special cases.
